text:
maria: Quick heads-up — we need to coordinate a base-image eviction + rootless runtime change this week. RBAC tweak, KMS-backed cosign signing, and audit fields need to be locked down before the rebuild pipeline runs. Can folks chime in with blockers?

ben: Which images are in-scope? runtime/base:ubuntu-min, runtime/base:glibc-slim? Also are we changing container runtime flags or just image artifacts?

maria: In-scope: runtime/base:ubuntu-min (sha256:aa11...), runtime/substrate:toolchain (sha256:bb22...). Primarily artifact changes but we'll flip the runtime rootless flag on staging nodes as part of the canary. Link: https://corp.internal/rebuilds/rootless-evict (internal)

alisa: RBAC note — we need a new role grant for the signer service account (keystore-signer@infra) to be able to use the KMS key. Suggest IAM role "image.signer" that maps to kms:Encrypt/Sign. Also: audit logs must capture signer principal + key_id + image_digest. Datadog/Logship schema to be updated.

sam: quick cosign example we'll run in the pipeline:
```
# sign using GCP KMS key URI
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/cosign-key 
  --annotations rebuild_id=177888 --annotations sbom_url=https://sbom.corp/rootless-177888.json 
  gcr.io/redwood/runtime/base@sha256:aa11...
```

security-oncall: For vuln triage: please attach SBOM and attestation to each image. If any CVE with CVSS >= 7.0 is introduced by the rebuild we stop the rollout and trigger incident triage. Also require trace_id on all signing audit events.

ben: Approval flow question — who is the approver for the RBAC change? We need an iam-admins sign-off before we push the terraform.

alisa: assign iam-admins -> @sam and @security-oncall as approvers for the change. I'll open the PR and add the terraform plan snippet.

maria: Canary plan: deploy signed images to staging first (5% runtime nodes with label evict=canary). If green for 12h with no regressions, ramp to 50% then 100% in a rolling window. Eviction will be performed by draining nodes with label evict=true to trigger new pods pulling signed images.

sam: drain snippet:
```
kubectl label node <node> evict=true
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
```

devops-bot: pipeline 672124 queued: base-image-rebuild-rootless #177888 (ETA ~2h). Logs will stream to CI console. :gear:

security-oncall: Audit log schema (minimal): [principal, key_id, image_digest, cosign_signature, sbom_url, rebuild_id, trace_id, canary_tag]. Please ensure logs are exported to long-term store (splunk-audit) and that retention policy meets compliance.

ben: Will the keystore rotation affect any running clusters? We need a fallback plan if KMS access flaps during rollout.

alisa: fallback: keep previous cosign key active for 24h overlap; pipeline will validate signatures against both key versions. If KMS fails, we fallback to prior key verification step and pause rollout. I'll update terraform to add key versioning.

maria: Owner assignments: maria -> overall coord, alisa -> RBAC + audit schema, sam -> pipeline cosign integration + drain scripts, ben -> rollout ops + canary checks, security-oncall -> vuln triage and incident playbook updates. Meeting 30m in #eng-security-review at 14:00 to finalize PRs.

maria: Thanks — tagging everyone to make sure RBAC/Terraform PRs land before pipeline start. :white_check_mark:
